content:
Julia's rowing speed is 20 feet per 16 seconds, which simplifies to 1.25 feet per second. The shore is 64 seconds away, so the distance to shore is:

\[
\text{Distance} = \left(\frac{20 \text{ feet}}{16 \text{ seconds}}\right) \times 64 \text{ seconds} = 80 \text{ feet}.
\]

The boat takes on water at a rate of 2 liters for every 10 feet rowed. Over 80 feet, the total water taken on is:

\[
\text{Water} = \left(\frac{2 \text{ liters}}{10 \text{ feet}}\right) \times 80 \text{ feet} = 16 \text{ liters}.
\]

Answer: 16 liters
